fiches.titre: Scrambled eggs with shrimp and Chinese chives
fiches.contexte: Chinese chives are nicknamed “the herb that lifts Yang”; together with shrimp, they warm the Kidney. A quick dish for a cold lower back, fatigue with a sense of cold, and low libido.

ingredients.nom: Chinese chives (jiu cai), cut into 3 cm (1 in) lengths

variantes.nom: In a frying pan or wok

etapes.texte: Beat the eggs ({oeufs}) with half the salt ({sel}).
Heat half the oil ({huile}) until very hot, pour in the eggs and stir gently until they set but are still soft. Set aside.
Add the rest of the oil, the ginger ({gingembre}), then the shrimp ({crevettes}). Stir-fry them until they turn pink.
Add the Chinese chives ({ciboule}) and the rest of the salt, and stir-fry over high heat just until they wilt.
Return the eggs to the pan, give it one last stir and serve right away with rice.

fiches.precautions: A warming dish: avoid it if you have signs of Heat (red tongue, thirst, pimples, fever) or a seafood allergy.
notes: You'll find Chinese chives in bunches in Asian grocery stores: flat leaves, with a taste somewhere between garlic and chives. If you can't find them, use very thinly sliced leek or regular chives.

fiches.titre: Fox nut, lotus seed and Chinese yam congee
fiches.contexte: Fox nuts and lotus seeds “tighten”: they help the Kidney hold in what is leaking out (seminal emissions, urine leaks, soft stools). Chinese yam supports the Spleen and Kidney. A mild, nourishing bowl that also calms the mind.

ingredients.nom: dried fox nuts (euryale seeds, qian shi)
fresh Chinese yam (shan yao), diced (or 30 g dried)

etapes.texte: Soak the fox nuts ({qianshi}) and lotus seeds ({lotus}) in cold water, then drain.
Bring the water ({eau}) to a boil with the fox nuts and lotus seeds, then let it simmer, covered.
Add the rinsed rice ({riz}), yam ({shanyao}) and jujubes ({dattes}). Let it simmer with the lid slightly ajar, stirring from time to time, until it turns thick and creamy.
Serve hot. Thin it with a little hot water if the congee has gotten too thick.

variantes.nom: In a rice cooker or multicooker

etapes.texte: Soak the fox nuts ({qianshi}) and lotus seeds ({lotus}) in cold water, then drain.

etapes.titre: Put everything in the inner pot
etapes.texte: Put the rinsed rice ({riz}), fox nuts, lotus seeds, yam ({shanyao}), jujubes ({dattes}) and water ({eau}) in the inner pot.
Start the Porridge or Congee program.
Stir and serve hot.

fiches.precautions: A dish that “tightens”: avoid it if you have dry constipation or a swollen, painful belly.
notes: Fox nuts (small white and red balls) and lotus seeds are sold dried in Asian grocery stores.
You can make a big batch: it keeps for 3 days in the fridge.

fiches.titre: Braised chicken with chestnuts and shiitake mushrooms
fiches.contexte: Chestnut is nicknamed the “Kidney fruit”: it strengthens the lower back and knees. With chicken and ginger, it makes a fall dish that warms the Spleen and Kidney.

principe.fr: Tonify the Kidney, strengthen the Spleen

ingredients.nom: dried shiitake mushrooms, soaked for 30 min
water (including the strained shiitake soaking water)

variantes.nom: In a cast-iron casserole pot or saucepan

etapes.texte: Brown the chicken ({poulet}) in the oil ({huile}) with the ginger ({gingembre}) and the white parts of the spring onions ({cebette}).
Add the shiitakes ({shiitake}) cut in half, the soy sauce ({soja}) and the water ({eau}). Cover and let it simmer gently.
Add the chestnuts ({chataignes}) and keep cooking uncovered to reduce the sauce.
Sprinkle with the green parts of the spring onions and serve with rice.
On the Sauté setting, if your cooker has one, brown the chicken ({poulet}) in the oil ({huile}) with the ginger ({gingembre}) and the white parts of the spring onions ({cebette}).
Add the shiitakes ({shiitake}), chestnuts ({chataignes}), soy sauce ({soja}) and water ({eau}). Simmer or Stew program.
Sprinkle with the green parts of the spring onions and serve with rice.
Brown the chicken ({poulet}) in the oil ({huile}) with the ginger ({gingembre}) and the white parts of the spring onions ({cebette}).
Add the shiitakes ({shiitake}), soy sauce ({soja}) and water ({eau}). Close the lid and start timing once it starts to hiss.
Let the pressure drop, add the chestnuts ({chataignes}) and let the sauce reduce uncovered.
Sprinkle with the green parts of the spring onions and serve with rice.

notes: With fresh chestnuts: cut a slit in each one, boil them for 15 minutes and peel them while they're still hot.

fiches.titre: Braised lamb with fennel and fennel seeds
fiches.contexte: Fennel seeds warm the Liver meridian and the lower belly; lamb and ginger warm the Kidney and Spleen. For cold-type pain in the lower belly, periods that come with a feeling of cold, and icy hands and feet.

ingredients.nom: lamb shoulder or neck, cut into pieces

etapes.texte: Brown the lamb ({agneau}) in the oil ({huile}) on all sides.
Add the ginger ({gingembre}), garlic ({ail}) and fennel seeds ({graines}), and stir until fragrant.
Pour in the water ({eau}), add salt ({sel}), cover and let it simmer very gently.
Add the fennel ({fenouil}) and carrots ({carotte}), and keep cooking until everything is meltingly tender.
Serve hot, with rice or millet.
On the Sauté setting, if your cooker has one, brown the lamb ({agneau}) in the oil ({huile}) with the ginger ({gingembre}), garlic ({ail}) and fennel seeds ({graines}).
Add the fennel ({fenouil}), carrots ({carotte}), water ({eau}) and salt ({sel}). Simmer or Stew program.
Serve hot, with rice or millet.
Brown the lamb ({agneau}) in the oil ({huile}) with the ginger ({gingembre}), garlic ({ail}) and fennel seeds ({graines}).
Add the fennel ({fenouil}), carrots ({carotte}), water ({eau}) and salt ({sel}). Close the lid and start timing once it starts to hiss.
Let the pressure drop on its own and serve.

fiches.precautions: A very warming dish: not if you have a fever, a red tongue, intense thirst or hot flashes.
notes: Mutton works too; cook it half an hour longer.

fiches.titre: Duck soup with Chinese yam and goji berries
fiches.contexte: Duck nourishes Yin without weighing you down; Chinese yam supports the Spleen, Lung and Kidney, and goji nourishes the Liver and Kidney. For a dry mouth, night sweats, and feeling hot late in the day.

ingredients.nom: fresh Chinese yam (shan yao), cut into chunks (or 40 g dried)

etapes.texte: Drop the duck ({canard}) into boiling water, then drain and rinse: the broth will be clearer and less fatty.
Put the duck back in the cold water ({eau}) with the ginger ({gingembre}) and the white parts of the spring onions ({cebette}). Bring to a simmer and cook covered, skimming off the foam at the start.
Add the yam ({shanyao}) and keep cooking.
Add the goji berries ({goji}) and salt ({sel}).
Skim off the fat if needed and serve with the green parts of the spring onions.
Drop the duck ({canard}) into boiling water, then drain and rinse.
Put the duck, yam ({shanyao}), ginger ({gingembre}), spring onion whites ({cebette}) and water ({eau}) in the inner pot. Soup program.
Add the goji ({goji}) and salt ({sel}), and leave it on Keep Warm.
Skim off the fat if needed and serve.
Drop the duck ({canard}) into boiling water, then drain and rinse.
Put in the duck, yam ({shanyao}), ginger ({gingembre}), spring onion whites ({cebette}) and water ({eau}). Close the lid and start timing once it starts to hiss.
Let the pressure drop, add the goji ({goji}) and salt ({sel}) and let it simmer.
Skim off the fat if needed and serve.

fiches.precautions: Duck is cooling: if you often feel cold or have soft stools, double the ginger.
notes: Once the broth has cooled, it's easy to skim: the fat sets on the surface.

fiches.titre: Pan-fried chicken livers with spinach and goji
fiches.contexte: In Chinese dietary therapy, liver nourishes the Liver: chicken livers, spinach and goji nourish the Blood. For tired eyes, floaters, cramps and brittle nails.

principe.fr: Nourish the Liver, tonify the Blood

etapes.texte: Heat half the oil ({huile}) until very hot and sear the livers ({foies}) with the ginger ({gingembre}): they should stay pink in the middle. Set aside.
In the rest of the oil, fry the garlic ({ail}), then the spinach ({epinards}) until it wilts.
Return the livers to the pan, add the goji ({goji}) and soy sauce ({soja}), and stir over the heat.
Serve right away, with rice.

fiches.precautions: Rich in vitamin A: if you're pregnant, limit organ meats to a small portion now and then, and ask your midwife or doctor for advice.
notes: Overcooked livers turn dry and bitter: take them off the heat as soon as they're browned.

fiches.contexte: Cucumber, tofu and seaweed are cooling and drain Dampness through the urine. A light broth for dark urine, intimate itching, a bitter taste in the mouth, and hot weather.

etapes.texte: Soak the wakame ({wakame}) in cold water, then drain.
Bring the water ({eau}) to a simmer with the ginger ({gingembre}) and soy sauce ({soja}).
Add the tofu ({tofu}), cucumber ({concombre}) and wakame, and let it simmer.
Sprinkle with spring onion ({cebette}) and serve warm.

fiches.precautions: A cooling dish: if you often feel cold or have soft stools, save it for hot weather and add ginger.
notes: You'll find dried wakame in Asian grocery stores or the organic aisle; it swells a lot.

fiches.titre: Stir-fried wood ear mushrooms with celery, garlic and ginger
fiches.contexte: Wood ear mushrooms (mu er) gently get the Blood moving; celery calms Liver Yang. A side dish for fixed pain, periods with clots, high blood pressure and throbbing temples.

principe.fr: Get the Blood moving, clear the vessels

ingredients.nom: celery stalks, sliced on the diagonal

variantes.nom: In a frying pan or wok

etapes.texte: Soak the wood ear mushrooms ({muer}) in lukewarm water, then rinse them and cut off the hard parts.
Fry the garlic ({ail}) and ginger ({gingembre}) in the hot oil ({huile}).
Add the carrot ({carotte}), celery ({celeri}) and mushrooms, and stir-fry over high heat.
Add the soy sauce ({soja}), stir and serve right away.

fiches.precautions: Wood ear mushrooms thin the blood: if you take a blood thinner, are pregnant, or have surgery coming up, ask for advice.
notes: You'll find them dried in Asian grocery stores; 15 g dried makes a big bowlful once they've swollen.

fiches.contexte: A classic kitchen remedy at the very start of a chill-type cold: chills, clear runny nose, stiff neck. Spring onion whites and ginger make you sweat a little, and the rice protects the Stomach.

ingredients.nom: spring onion whites, with their roots, washed

etapes.texte: Bring the water ({eau}) to a boil with the rinsed rice ({riz}), then let it simmer with the lid slightly ajar.
Add the ginger ({gingembre}) and the spring onion whites ({cebette}), crushed with the flat of a knife. Let it simmer a little longer.
Add salt ({sel}) and have it piping hot, then bundle up so you sweat a little.

variantes.nom: In a rice cooker or multicooker

etapes.texte: Put the rinsed rice ({riz}) and water ({eau}) in the inner pot and start the Porridge or Congee program.
Add the ginger ({gingembre}) and the crushed spring onion whites ({cebette}), close the lid and leave on Keep Warm.
Add salt ({sel}) and have it piping hot, then bundle up.

fiches.precautions: Only at the very start of a chill-type cold. If there's a sore throat, a high fever or yellow phlegm, it's no longer the right time.
notes: The aromatics only cook for a few minutes: that's what keeps them effective.

fiches.titre: Beef bone broth with carrots and ginger
fiches.contexte: A long-simmered broth that supports the Kidney, bones and tendons. For tired knees and lower back, recovery after illness, and long winters.

principe.fr: Tonify the Kidney, strengthen the bones

etapes.texte: Cover the bones ({os}) with cold water, bring to a boil, then drain and rinse: the broth will be clearer.
Put the bones back in the cold water ({eau}) with the vinegar ({vinaigre}), ginger ({gingembre}), onion ({oignon}) and star anise ({anis}). Let it barely simmer, covered.
Add the carrots ({carotte}) and jujubes ({dattes}) and keep cooking.
Strain, add salt ({sel}) and serve a hot bowlful. Save the marrow and the shank meat for another meal.
Cover the bones ({os}) with cold water, bring to a boil, then drain and rinse.

Put in the bones, the water ({eau}) up to the inner pot's limit, the vinegar ({vinaigre}), ginger ({gingembre}), onion ({oignon}), star anise ({anis}), carrots ({carotte}) and jujubes ({dattes}). Slow Cook or Long Soup program.
Strain, add salt ({sel}) and serve.
Cover the bones ({os}) with cold water, bring to a boil, then drain and rinse.

Put the bones back in with the water ({eau}) up to the max line, the vinegar ({vinaigre}), ginger ({gingembre}), onion ({oignon}) and star anise ({anis}). Close the lid and start timing once it starts to hiss.
Let the pressure drop, add the carrots ({carotte}) and jujubes ({dattes}) and let it simmer uncovered.
Strain, add salt ({sel}) and serve.

notes: It keeps for 4 days in the fridge and freezes very well in portions.
Once cooled, it sets into a jelly: that's a good sign.

fiches.titre: Warm oysters with ginger and spring onion
fiches.contexte: Oyster nourishes Yin and Essence and calms the mind; its shell is a classic remedy for holding in Essence and calming. Barely cooked, with ginger to balance their cooling nature.

ingredients.nom: fresh ginger, cut into fine julienne

etapes.texte: Set the oysters ({huitres}) cupped side down in a steamer basket over boiling water and cover: they'll open slightly.
Remove the flat top shell of each oyster with a knife, keeping the juice.
Top each one with a little ginger ({gingembre}), spring onion ({cebette}), a drop of soy sauce ({soja}) and sesame oil ({huile}). Serve warm.
Preheat the oven on the broil setting to 220 °C (425 °F).
Set the oysters ({huitres}) cupped side down on a baking sheet, propped up with crumpled foil, and put them in the oven: they'll open slightly.
Open them, then top each one with a little ginger ({gingembre}), spring onion ({cebette}), a drop of soy sauce ({soja}) and sesame oil ({huile}).

fiches.precautions: Throw away any that stay closed after cooking. Not if you have a seafood allergy.
notes: Out of season, frozen shucked oysters can be pan-fried for 1 minute with the ginger.

fiches.contexte: A great classic for the Kidney and Essence: graying or thinning hair, failing memory, dry constipation, tired lower back. Drink it warm at breakfast or as an afternoon snack.

variantes.nom: In a saucepan, with a blender

etapes.texte: Dry-toast the sesame ({sesame}), walnuts ({noix}) and rice ({riz}) in a frying pan, stirring constantly, until fragrant.
Blend everything until smooth with the jujubes ({dattes}) and half the water ({eau}).
Pour into a saucepan with the rest of the water and let it thicken over low heat, stirring.
Serve warm and plain: the jujubes are enough to sweeten it.
Dry-toast the sesame ({sesame}), walnuts ({noix}) and rice ({riz}) in a frying pan until fragrant.
Put everything in the blender with the jujubes ({dattes}) and water ({eau}), and start the Smooth Soup or Plant Milk program.
Serve warm.

fiches.precautions: Rich and fatty: if you have soft stools or diarrhea, wait until it passes.
notes: Extra toasted sesame keeps for 2 weeks in a closed jar.
